sources.entry: MinimalClock - Simple and elegant screensaver that displays the time.

summary.one_liner: MinimalClock is a macOS screen saver that displays the current time.
summary.what_it_does: MinimalClock is a screen saver for macOS that shows the time. The README is short and covers installation and removal only. It is distributed as a downloadable zip file that is unzipped and installed by double-clicking. The README includes a separate download link for macOS Catalina 10.15. Once installed, it is selected in System Preferences under Desktop & Screen Saver. The README does not describe configuration options or the visual design beyond the name and the time display.
use_cases: display time as a screen saver on mac
minimal clock for idle mac screen
replace default macos screen saver with a clock
how_to_run: Download the MinimalClock zip file from the link in the README (a separate link is provided for macOS Catalina 10.15).
Unzip the file, double-click it, and choose Install.
Open System Preferences, choose Desktop & Screen Saver, click MinimalClock, and choose OK.
If the screen saver does not work, open System Preferences, go to Security & Privacy, and click Open Anyway in the General section.
Click the screen saver preview, then click Open.
notable: Displays the time as a minimal screen saver for macOS
Installs by double-clicking an unzipped package
Includes a separate download for macOS Catalina 10.15
Includes uninstall steps via Desktop & Screen Saver settings
caveats: README does not state the license
Install may require allowing an unidentified app in Security & Privacy settings
